we introduce a novel factorized HOI detection model, that can be used for zero-shot detection of HOIs.
we propose a factorized HOI detector that disentangles verbs and objects and enables the model to detect new HOI categories at test time.
we are able to scale HOI recognition to thousands of novel HOI classes, while still maintaining comparable performance to the best supervised models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
zero-shot HOI detection can be performed at the level of individual HOI instances, without relying on the use of class-level embeddings.

zero-shot learning can be used as a powerful tool for scaling up HOI detection to the long tail, and we hope our results motivate further work in this direction.
